description: This file defines an Angular service named ApiService that provides HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) encapsulated around Angular's HttpClient. It prefixes requests with a base URL from environment configuration and exposes methods for making API calls with typed responses.

classes.name: ApiService
classes.description: A service class providing a wrapper around Angular's HttpClient for standardized API requests.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the specified API endpoint, returning an Observable of the specified type.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with a request body to the specified API endpoint.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PUT request with a request body to the specified API endpoint.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PATCH request with a request body to the specified API endpoint.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Performs an HTTP DELETE request to the specified API endpoint.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Constructs the full URL for an API request by combining the base URL with the provided path.
